title: Data Scientist, Marketing
location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
description: Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us! We’re looking for a Marketing Data Scientist to join Figma’s Data Science team and help shape how we attract, engage, and grow our customers. You’ll partner with Marketing and cross-functional teams to understand customer behavior, measure marketing effectiveness, and identify growth opportunities. Through experimentation, statistical analysis, and scalable measurement frameworks, you’ll connect marketing programs to business outcomes and help leaders decide where to invest. This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States. What you’ll do at Figma: Shape strategy and drive business growth: Proactively identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and use data to influence where Marketing invests and how we grow the business Collaborate with Marketing leaders to identify important business questions, prioritize analytical opportunities, and shape marketing strategy Develop measurement frameworks that connect campaigns and channels to customer acquisition, product adoption, pipeline, and revenue across self-serve and sales-assisted businesses Design experiments and apply causal inference methods to measure incremental impact and guide investment decisions Analyze customer journeys, audiences, and campaign performance to identify opportunities to improve targeting, conversion, and engagement Build reliable datasets, dashboards, and analytical tools with Data Engineering and Marketing Operations, enabling teams to monitor performance and make decisions independently Translate complex findings into clear recommendations, communicating uncertainty and methodological tradeoffs to senior leaders We’d love to hear from you if you have: 5+ years of experience in data science, marketing analytics, or a related analytical role, including experience informing marketing decisions Experience applying data science to top-of-funnel, brand, and lifecycle marketing, connecting campaigns to customer and business outcomes Experience with marketing mix modeling, attribution, geographic experiments, or other incrementality methods Advanced SQL skills and proficiency in Python, R, or similar tools for analysis and modeling Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional decisions through clear analysis and communication, while independently defining problems, prioritizing work, and carrying projects from an initial question through recommendations and follow-up measurement While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have: Experience in B2B SaaS, particularly businesses combining self-serve growth with sales-assisted acquisition and expansion Experience building predictive models for audience targeting, conversion, customer value, or engagement Experience with brand measurement, surveys, social listening, or combining research and behavioral data At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
